finding: The original V5 run (commit 4570d93) did NOT faithfully implement the structural models named in the prospective protocol. The following substitutions were made:

fidelity_failures.protocol_claim: Kalman local-linear trend, signal = latent_slope / state_uncertainty
fidelity_failures.actual_implementation: Rolling OLS linear regression on log-mid over fixed window. Not a recursive state-space filter.

fidelity_failures.protocol_claim: Gaussian mixture on [return, vol, range, spread, trend]. Posterior state probs as continuous signal modifier.
fidelity_failures.actual_implementation: Volatility threshold (median) gating momentum sign. No GMM, no posterior probabilities.

fidelity_failures.protocol_claim: Rank 13 pairs by [return, residual, trend_persistence]. Top vs bottom, top-2 vs bottom-2.
fidelity_failures.actual_implementation: Per-pair 6-bar momentum. No cross-sectional ranking across 13 pairs. No panel synchronization.

fidelity_failures.protocol_claim: Causal PCA factor from panel. Residual momentum/drift at slow horizons.
fidelity_failures.actual_implementation: Single-series self-residual (ret[i] - mean(ret[i-24:i])). No PCA, no panel factor, no cross-pair structure.

fidelity_failures.protocol_claim: Small causal TCN or GRU. Inputs: returns, range, spread, time. Train on dev only.
fidelity_failures.actual_implementation: Fixed exponential-decay weighted sum of returns + range - spread. No neural network, no training, no learned parameters.

fidelity_failures.protocol_claim: Enter/wait/abstain based on expected_move / cost / uncertainty / time_left. State sources: S1_kalman, S2_regime.
fidelity_failures.actual_implementation: 6-bar momentum sum vs spread+cost threshold. Does not consume S1/S2 model outputs. No uncertainty, no time-left.

consequence: The V5 negative result (0 survivors) is valid as a result of the code that was executed, but it does NOT constitute evidence that the named structural models (Kalman, GMM, cross-sectional, PCA, GRU/TCN, cost-aware stopping) lack predictive power. The actual models were never tested.
preservation: All original V5 artifacts remain unchanged at their committed SHAs. This postmortem does not alter any prior result.
next_step: V5R_TRUE_STRUCTURAL_MODELS: implement the actual named models and test them prospectively.
